available.quote: If the applicant for a Minnesota license holds a license in another state and is seeking Minnesota licensure without examination based on reciprocity, then the application for the Minnesota license must be accompanied by the application and examination fee of $50

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid comparable license in the qualifying state, which must administer a statewide licensing program with examination and qualifying experience comparable to Minnesota's; applicant must have held the license continuously for at least one year before applying in Minnesota.
requirements.quote: The parties to the agreement must administer a statewide licensing program that includes examination and qualifying experience or training comparable to Minnesota's.

is_mandatory.quote: A person who provides or performs building construction or improvement services shall not: (1) provide or perform building construction or improvement services without being registered, if required to be registered under this section

title_protection.quote: Except as provided in subdivision 6, no persons required to be licensed by subdivision 1 may act or hold themselves out as a residential building contractor, residential remodeler, residential roofer, or manufactured home installer for compensation without a license issued by the commissioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delayed, obstructed, or otherwise failed to cooperate with a commissioner's investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: delayed, obstructed, or otherwise failed to cooperate with a commissioner's investigation, including a request to give testimony, to provide data and information, to produce documents, things, apparatus, devices, equipment, or materials, or to enter and access all areas of any property

disciplinary_grounds.quote: retaliated in any manner against any employee or person who makes a complaint, is questioned by, cooperates with, or provides information to the commissioner

disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaged in any fraudulent, deceptive, or dishonest act or practice

disciplinary_grounds.quote: performed work in connection with the permit, license, registration, or certificate or conducted the person's affairs in a manner that demonstrates incompetence, untrustworthiness, or financial irresponsibility

disciplinary_grounds.description: Filed an application that is incomplete in any material respect or contains false or misleading statements

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to use proceeds of payment for construction or improvement to pay labor, skill, material, and machinery
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has failed to use the proceeds of any payment made to the licensee for the construction of, or any improvement to, residential real estate, as defined in section 326B.802, subdivision 13, for the payment of labor, skill, material, and machinery contributed to the construction or improvement

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in an act or practice that results in compensation to an aggrieved owner or lessee from the contractor recovery fund
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has engaged in an act or practice that results in compensation to an aggrieved owner or lessee from the contractor recovery fund pursuant to section 326B.89

bonding_required.quote: All bonds that are required by this chapter must be in the form of a corporate surety bond conditioned upon the faithful and lawful performance of all work contracted for or performed in the state of Minnesota.

insurance_required.quote: Each licensee shall have and maintain in effect commercial general liability insurance, which includes premises and operations insurance and products and completed operations insurance, with limits of at least $100,000 per occurrence, $300,000 aggregate limit for bodily injury, and property damage insurance with limits of at least $25,000

definition_quote.value: "Building construction or improvement services" means public or private sector commercial or residential building construction or improvement services.
definition_quote.quote: "Building construction or improvement services" means public or private sector commercial or residential building construction or improvement services.

methods_authorized.quote: "Special skill" means one of the following eight categories: (a) Excavation... (b) Masonry and concrete... (c) Carpentry... (d) Interior finishing... (e) Exterior finishing... (f) Drywall and plaster... (g) Residential roofing... (h) General installation specialties.

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: The license number of a licensee must appear in any advertising by that licensee including but not limited to signs, vehicles, business cards, published display ads, flyers, brochures, websites, and Internet ads.

insurance_personal_injury_minimum_usd.quote: commercial general liability insurance, which includes premises and operations insurance and products and completed operations insurance, with limits of at least $100,000 per occurrence, $300,000 aggregate limit for bodily injury

insurance_property_damage_minimum_usd.quote: property damage insurance with limits of at least $25,000 or a policy with a single limit for bodily injury and property damage of $300,000 per occurrence and $300,000 aggregate limits

contract_must_be_written.quote: All agreements including proposals, estimates, bids, quotations, contracts, purchase orders, and change orders between a licensee and a customer for the performance of a licensee's services must be in writing

right_of_rescission_days.quote: A person who has entered into a written contract with a residential building contractor, residential remodeler, or residential roofer to provide goods and services to be paid by the insured from the proceeds of a property or casualty insurance policy has the right to cancel the contract within 72 hours after the insured has been notified by the insurer that the claim has been denied.

minimum_annual_revenue_threshold_usd.quote: a person whose total gross annual receipts for performing specialty skills for which licensure would be required under this section do not exceed $15,000

state_preempts_local_registration_fees.quote: Except as provided in subdivision 2, a political subdivision may not require a person licensed under sections 326B.802 to 326B.885 to also be licensed or pay a registration or other fee related to licensure under any ordinance, law, rule, or regulation of the political subdivision.

local_trade_licensing_preserved.quote: This section does not prohibit a political subdivision from requiring licensure or certification under any ordinance, law, rule, or regulation of the political subdivision for persons who engage in the installation of an on-site sewage treatment system.

registration_renewal_interval_years.quote: A residential contractor, residential remodeler, and residential roofer license shall have a renewal period of two years.
